title: Catalytic Hydrogen Evolution Reaction on Surfaces of Metal-Nanoparticle-Coated Zinc-Based Oxides by First-Principles Calculations
meta: International Journal of Hydrogen Energy, 2022 — IF: 7.2
soWhat: Used computational simulation to compare how chemically active different material combinations are, find the best candidates for hydrogen evolution, and explain the thermodynamics behind them alongside the related experiments.
problem: Screening the plausible material combinations, then giving a mechanistic explanation for what the simulations showed.
role: I analysed the catalytic process from both the thermodynamic and the kinetic side.
method: Au/ZnO showed the best thermodynamic preference, while Pt/ZnO had the lowest kinetic barrier together with a hydrogen spillover mechanism. That combination explains why these materials show relatively strong catalytic performance in the related experimental literature.
